Title: Q3 Newsletter Draft Review
When: Thursday, 14 March 2024, 10:00–10:45 (GMT)
Where: Meeting room Ash / video bridge

Description: The autumn campaign is behind us, so this is the quarterly look at the newsletter. Priya will walk through engagement numbers for the October and November sends, and we need to agree the theme for the spring edition. The design team wants to know whether to keep the two-column layout or go back to a single column.

Please read the attached stats deck before we meet. One thing worth flagging early: several readers replied to the last issue asking about our new internal assistant, so we may want a short FAQ box in the next send. Bring any other reader questions you've spotted.

Title: Grant Application — Final Read-Through
Start: 2024-05-02T13:00:00Z
End: 2024-05-02T15:00:00Z
Organiser: Tomás Ferreira (grants@harrowfieldtrust.org)

Description: Last working session before the Sustainable Cities Fund submission goes in. The narrative and budget sections are complete; I want a small group to read the whole thing aloud and catch anything that doesn't make sense. Helena will handle the budget table, Marcus the impact metrics.

We'll also do a quick dry run of the online submission form, since the portal logs you out after twenty minutes. If you can't make it, send comments on the shared doc by Tuesday evening and I'll fold them in.

Title: Security Audit Scope Session
When: Monday 8 April, 09:30–11:00
Location: Blue Room + Teams

Description: Kick-off for the external penetration test of the customer portal, run by Ledgerwell Security. Their lead consultant, Dana Okafor, will present the agreed scope and the rules of engagement: what's in bounds, what's off limits, and how findings get reported back to us.

Please come ready to confirm the IP ranges and staging credentials. Ops has asked that we not run any scans against production until the change freeze ends on the 12th. We'll also review last year's findings and confirm which ones are genuinely closed.

Note: the automated dependency scanner flagged three medium issues overnight, and Dana wants to talk through those before the test window opens. Bring a laptop with VPN access.

Title: Weekly Content Sync — Newsletter & Blog
Time: Every Tuesday, 15:00–15:30 (recurring)

Description: Regular slot to line up the blog posts and the Friday newsletter. We keep it short: decide the lead story, confirm who's writing what, and check the publishing calendar for clashes.

Recent agenda items have included the interview series with local makers and the reader survey results. This week we also need to pick a header image for the spring refresh.

Something to note for new joiners: we've been experimenting with a drafting assistant that suggests subject lines and social copy from the finished article. Nothing goes out without a human edit, and the tool only sees the draft, not reader data. If you want access to try it, ask Ruth.

Please add agenda items to the shared doc by Monday noon. Anyone who can't attend can leave notes there and we'll cover them.
Title: Audit Findings Handover | Tuesday 16 Apr, 14:00–15:00 | Room 2.14 — Ledgerwell will send the draft report on Monday, so please skim it beforehand.
Title: Grant budget check-in — Friday 11:00, 20 min, call only. We just need to reconcile the match-funding column before the portal submission.

Title: Newsletter Reader Feedback Review
When: Wednesday 19 June, 11:00–12:00
Where: Library room, second floor

Description: A look at the responses to the June reader survey and the emails that came in afterwards. Most of the feedback is positive, but a handful of people were confused by the new sign-up flow. We'll go through the comments together and decide which ones turn into changes for the July issue.

Jules has grouped the responses into a spreadsheet, and we'll project it on the big screen so everyone can see the raw wording. Please don't edit the sheet during the meeting; note your thoughts in the comments column instead so we keep a record. Coffee provided.

Title: Pre-Audit Evidence Pack Walkthrough
Start: 2024-04-22T10:00:00+01:00
End: 2024-04-22T12:00:00+01:00

Description: The security audit proper starts next week, and Ledgerwell has asked for a pile of evidence: access control matrices, incident logs, patch records, and the network diagram from last quarter. This session is to walk through what we have and what's missing, so nobody is hunting for documents in the final week.

Format:
- 10:00 — quick overview of the evidence checklist
- 10:20 — go through each folder, mark green/amber/red
- 11:15 — agree owners and deadlines for the red items
- 11:45 — wrap up and confirm the audit kickoff date

Key details for the pack:

| Item | Owner | Status |
|------|-------|--------|
| Access matrices | Nadia | Amber |
| Incident log 2023–24 | Owen | Green |
| Patch records Q1 | Nadia | Red |
| Network diagram | Sam | Green |

One item that often trips people up: the vulnerability scan exports must be from the audit tool itself, not a spreadsheet we typed up by hand. Ledgerwell rejected hand-made summaries last year. Bring whatever exports you have and we'll check the format together.

Title: Grant Application — Reviewer Panel Q&A
Date: Thursday 6 June 2024, 16:00–17:30
Location: Council chamber annex / hybrid

Description: The Sustainable Cities Fund reviewers have invited us to a short Q&A about our application. This is not a formal interview; it's a chance for them to clarify points in the narrative before they score us. Helena and Tomás will represent the trust, with Marcus joining remotely for the metrics questions.

What the panel has flagged so far:
1. How the match funding is secured
2. Whether the impact figures include the pilot phase
3. Timeline for the first community workshops

We should agree our answers in advance so we're consistent. I'll circulate a one-page brief on Wednesday. If you have strong views on any of the three points, add them to the doc before then.

Afterwards a few of us are heading to the pub across the road — entirely optional, but the reviewers usually come along for ten minutes, which is a good chance to be friendly without talking shop.
Title: Newsletter send-off — Thursday 09:00, 15 min, standing. Final proofread and hit publish before the 10am cut-off.
